title: Revision clarifies an account’s appeal

captions.emotions: Feeling strong attraction to an idea

meaning: Releasing an unstable foundation can bring proportion to observations while preserving understanding of why one account attracts both people strongly.
text: An account’s appeal can remain after its familiar foundation is lost. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly releasing a judgement’s unstable basis. Justice in energy supports proportion between different observations. The Devil in emotions experiences strong attraction to an idea. Releasing an answer promising broad explanation may be difficult. Wanting its foundations considered substantially preserves material separately from fascination throughout the discussion between both people.

Suppose the idea that rarity makes objects interesting captivates you. Examining an ordinary object repeatedly drawing your gaze, you stop treating rarity as sufficient foundations. **Revision can clarify strong attraction while preserving proportion in judgement.** Attention to proportion distinguishes unusualness from a noticeable feature of form. An earlier account still tempts through simplicity. Your view nevertheless has different material. You can discuss what holds attention without requiring an appealing idea to explain every case while strong interest may remain before final understanding has appeared.

The risk is calling an ordinary object secretly rare to preserve the attractive account. Seeking proportion holds the initial observation steady: interest arose without known exceptional status. A judgement’s foundation is then not replaced by wanting confirmation. Your view can preserve fascination while each person distinguishes attraction towards a beautiful answer from a particular feature’s significance actually noticed together.
